versions.text: Criterion: Verify that V/STOL characteristics have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.7 V/STOL specific requirements (see table XC for guidance). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation.
